performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark for 28 days; contract gap is the root cause.

findings.text: Zero Meta and Google spend for all 28 days in window — $0 spent, 0 leads generated. Paid engine is completely off, not underperforming.
SOW gate: extension with Marwan is open and unresolved — contract lapse since June end blocks restarting the $75/day Meta budget.
GBP actions collapsed from ~8/day average to 0 for last 4 days (Aug 24–27), an 87.5% weekly drop — listing issue or reduced local intent probable.
Search clicks trending up — 3-day signal (Aug 25–27: 32, 43, 0) vs prior 3 (Aug 22–24: 10, 13, 43) is noisy; Aug 27 shows 0, data likely incomplete. 7d delta is +37.7%.
GHL shows 23 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments over 28 days — intake pipeline is not processing any inbound, consistent with ads being off.

suggestions.text: Resolve Marwan contract extension immediately — 28 days of $0 spend and 0 leads is a contract gap, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google have been at $0 spend and 0 leads for the full 28-day window (Jul 31–Aug 27). The SOW notes the extension with Marwan is open and gates the next 3 months — this is the direct blocker preventing the $75/day Meta budget from restarting. Sohib to confirm signed extension with Marwan by 2026-09-01. Success check: contract signed and paid ads back live within 48 hours of signature.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing — 4 consecutive zero-action days (Aug 24–27) after averaging 8+ actions/day earlier in the series.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for the last 4 recorded days (Aug 24–27) after averaging roughly 8 actions/day across July and early August — a confirmed 87.5% weekly drop. Check the Google Business Profile for suspension flags, ownership issues, or listing edits that may have triggered a review. Success check: GBP actions return to 5+ per day within 7 days of any fix applied, by 2026-09-04.

suggestions.text: Watch search clicks for 3 more days — Aug 27 shows 0 (likely incomplete); confirm whether +37.7% 7d trend holds before any SEO action.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks are up 37.7% week-over-week but the Aug 27 data point reads 0, which is likely a data lag rather than a real drop. No action warranted until the next 3 full days of data are available. Re-check on 2026-08-31: if the upward trend holds (daily clicks consistently above 20), escalate to Nacer for SEO attribution review.
